audience: marketers and shop owners who text their customers with SlickText

useCases.title: Check message credits and brand analytics
useCases.text: The AI reads the message credits for the billing period (used and available) and brand analytics such as contact growth and messages sent.

useCases.title: See how a text campaign performed
useCases.text: The AI lists campaigns and reads one campaign's contacts reached, clicks, unsubscribes, orders and revenue.

useCases.title: Count contacts in your lists and segments
useCases.text: The AI lists contact lists with their contact count over all statuses, and the contacts that match a segment.

useCases.title: Review inbox conversations and messages
useCases.text: The AI lists two-way inbox conversations by status with contact, assigned user and tags, and reads the messages sent and received.

useCases.title: Check your text-to-join keywords
useCases.text: The AI lists keywords with their auto-response and opt-in messages, and the lists that people who text a keyword are added to.

useCases.title: Find a contact, or add or update one
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by phone or email first, then creates one, updates fields or adds the contact to lists. Subscribe only people who agreed to texts.
